svg.title: Bubo — agentic AI code review
svg.desc: Bubo: agentic AI code review. AI code review that only speaks when it has something to say. Runs the LLM of your choice against the diff and posts only actionable findings as inline threads. GitLab MRs, GitHub PRs, Codex or Claude, MCP server. github.com/mountainowl/bubo

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
